approved_lines.voiceover: Kodiak still has a highway safety case to finish.
On September eighth, Kodiak reported 93% readiness through August.
That measures claims and evidence materially complete.
It is not a 93% chance of a safe trip.
The June filing names Texas as the initial launch market.
It already reports freight runs between Dallas and Houston.
Year-end is the target. The evidence still has work to do.
